syllabus_extract: Introduction to sonobuoy system. Purpose and technical details of active and passive sonobuoy.
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of sonobuoy types and signal transmission principles; Safety: No live equipment handling; Supervision: Instructor monitors understanding.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a sonobuoy?
Define the basic theory of communication in this context.
List two types of sonobuoys based on their operation.

development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Sonobuoy system overview
Purpose of sonobuoys
Signal transmission basics
Receiver and transmitter roles

Active sonobuoy technical details
Passive sonobuoy technical details
Comparison of active and passive
Frequency ranges used
Detection and reporting cycle

Sonobuoy deployment procedures
Signal processing basics
Data interpretation fundamentals
System limitations
Maintenance overview

summary_questions: Explain the difference between active and passive sonobuoys.
Describe the basic theory of communication as applied to sonobuoys.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the knowledge of sonobuoy systems bridges the understanding of general communication systems covered in LP 02.
